text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—I gave the race everything I had, and 
managed to bring home a victory safely."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"But... the fans were disappointed, saying 
it was scary and not cute at all. We 
couldn't celebrate together..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"It must be because my win wasn't 
impressive enough. If I can run way 
cooler, I'm sure they'll come to like me 
again!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"My next goal is one more race before the 
Shuka Sho: the Queen Stakes... Please look 
forward to it!"
